title: AI assistant

hints.continue: Writes on from your cursor, in the document's style.
hints.rewrite: Rewrites the text you have selected.
hints.ask: Answers a question about the document.

placeholders.ask: What do you want to know?

selectFirst: Select text in the document to rewrite it.
stopped: Stopped. Nothing was added to the document.

insertWhere.other: Insert adds it after the paragraph with your cursor.

insertErrors.stale: Someone edited the document just now. Try Insert again.
insertErrors.lost: The document was reloaded, so the original text can no longer be found. Select it and rewrite again.
insertErrors.busy: Pause typing for a moment, then Insert.
insertErrors.offline: Insert is paused until the document reconnects.
